incidents.name: Incident on 2010-04-28 19:32:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-04-28 19:32:00 - One of the file servers is having issues. Looking into it.
  • 2010-04-28 19:49:05 - All systems back to normal

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-04-27 12:21:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-04-27 12:21:00 - There have been multiple reports that folks in Germany can't connect to github.com, we're checking with Rackspace to see what's going on.
  • 2010-04-27 13:04:00 - European users should be 100% now. Outage appears to be limited to a specific ISP that was preventing traffic from reaching many US sites.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-04-23 09:55:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-04-23 09:55:00 - Sporadic disruptions with one of the file servers. Some repositories are currently unavailable. We're investigating.
  • 2010-04-23 10:02:00 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-04-20 23:08:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-04-20 23:08:00 - One of the file servers is not responding. Looking into it.
  • 2010-04-20 23:19:00 - File server is operating again. We had a simultaneous failure on the FS3 storage server pair.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-04-19 07:33:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-04-19 07:33:00 - Some users are reporting problems authenticating via SSH. We're investigating the problem now.
  • 2010-04-19 07:56:00 - The SSH problem should be fixed. We're looking into a reverse DNS problem that was causing a single file server's SSHD to misbehave.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-04-16 06:26:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-04-16 06:26:00 - Queues are backed up. Some operations delayed. We're investigating now.
  • 2010-04-16 06:40:00 - Queues unclogged. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-04-04 11:32:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-04-04 11:32:00 - One of the file servers is showing some strange behavior in trying to run the RPC server component. Investigating.
  • 2010-04-04 11:50:00 - All systems back to normal. There was a problem with the checkout of the main repository on the machine. All fixed up.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-30 05:03:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-03-30 05:03:00 - One of the file servers is misbehaving. Looking into it.
  • 2010-03-30 05:13:00 - The file server failed in a way that heartbeat did not detect it. Forced a failover and all file servers are back online. Investigating heartbeat failure now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-23 04:55:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-03-23 04:55:00 - Load balancer deploys complete.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-23 04:48:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-03-23 04:48:00 - Deploying some changes to the load balancer. Slight interruption possible.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-16 05:46:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-03-16 05:46:00 - Maintenance is complete. Partitions fscked successfully; should prevent future problems with disk space.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-16 05:00:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-03-16 05:00:00 - Scheduled maintenance starting now. Some repositories will be unavailable for a short time (about 15 minutes) over the next hour.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-16 00:05:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-03-16 00:05:00 - We will be running an fsck on two partitions of FS4 starting tonight at 22:00PDT. Expecting 15 min unavailability per partition.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-15 21:45:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-03-15 21:45:00 - A partition on fs4 is full, we're making space now.
  • 2010-03-15 21:49:00 - fs4 is working again. `df` is incorrectly reporting disk usage and we're investigating with @anchorsystems why that's happening.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-10 11:42:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-03-10 11:42:00 - Site is down hard. We've tracked it to the database and are researching further.
  • 2010-03-10 11:45:00 - Database came out of its funk and the site is back. Looking for a root cause now and keeping an eye on things for a bit.
  • 2010-03-10 11:55:00 - And we're back. Naughty changes to one of the puppet configs took mysql down for a few minutes. This won't happen again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-08 02:05:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-03-08 02:05:00 - We are seeing an unusually high amount of requests. Site should be back, investigating now.
  • 2010-03-08 02:10:00 - We've enhanced our rate limiting strategy and dealt with the problem requests.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-04 00:29:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-03-04 00:29:00 - We're investigating why users are getting "No such file or directory - /data/github/current/config/database.yml" when pushing
  • 2010-03-04 00:39:00 - database.yml is back, we're investigating the cause

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-03 06:12:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-03-03 06:12:00 - Maintenance is done. Hardware checks will go on in the background on the now-slave file server. All repos will remain available.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-03 06:00:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-03-03 06:00:00 - Maintenance starting now. Some repos will be unavailable for several minutes.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-03-03 05:31:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-03-03 05:31:00 - Maintenance starting at 22:00 PST for hardware checks on a misbehaving file server. Some repositories will be unavailable for a few minutes.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-26 21:23:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-02-26 21:23:00 - One file partition appears to be full, some users may receive "No space left on device" errors when pushing. We're making space now.
  • 2010-02-26 21:41:00 - Space has been freed on the full partition. We're investigating why the OS was not reporting the part as full.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-25 10:25:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-02-25 10:25:00 - Intermittent problems with search, working on the fix now.
  • 2010-02-25 11:21:00 - Search is back up and we're now running Solr 1.4.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-24 12:55:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-02-24 12:55:00 - Delays generating zip and tar archives. The queue has a big backlog but is catching up now.
  • 2010-02-24 13:12:00 - Archive queue has caught up. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-24 06:30:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-02-24 06:30:00 - fs3 was taken offline for a few minutes due to inactivity. You may have received a "repository temporarily unavailable" message during that time. We're researching the cause of the issue.
  • 2010-02-24 06:42:00 - Everything operating normally

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-19 21:49:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-02-19 21:49:00 - Some repos may be temporarily unavailable. We're bringin em back soon.
  • 2010-02-19 21:53:00 - Everything operating normally

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-15 06:28:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-02-15 06:28:00 - Scheduled maintenance for file server partition resizing has begun. A small percentage of repositories will be unavailable for 10-20 minutes at a time from now until 3:00 AM PST.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-13 02:04:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-02-13 02:04:00 - Scheduled maintenance tonight starting at 22:00 PST with 20 minute rolling unavailability windows of certain file system partitions. More details at http://github.com/blog/603-scheduled-maintenance-tonight-at-22-00-pst.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-12 02:50:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-02-12 02:50:00 - A transient network problem is causing sporadic problems with one of our file servers (fs5).
  • 2010-02-12 03:58:00 - fs5 networking has been stable for an hour now. We'll be monitoring this closely for future problems.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-11 00:14:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-02-11 00:14:00 - Site is currently unicorning. We are investigating.
  • 2010-02-11 00:16:00 - Back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-09 07:00:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-02-09 07:00:00 - Small outage just now was caused by a file server failover. We will soon have better FS isolation in place to reduce the impact of failover.
  • 2010-02-10 03:50:00 - A networking problem is causing an outage, we're investigating
  • 2010-02-10 04:15:00 - Network problem solved. We'll be looking into the root cause of this outage (signs point to HAProxy).

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-02-07 06:00:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2010-02-07 06:00:00 - Scheduled maintenance tonight at 10PM Pacific. No downtime expected.
